title: Column alignment is a hard invariant: every row renders exactly the report's column count with blanks in position
refs: specs/sbr-sales-by-representative.md Story 5 S5-R10; S5-N2; Story 18 S18-R6a
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the report with a rep expanded and the grand Totals row visible.
custom_steps:
1. Compare a summary row and a detail row column by column against the headers.
2. Look for any cell whose content has shifted into a neighbouring column or wrapped.
3. Look at the desktop Totals row's leading cells.
custom_expected:
1. Every rep summary row and every invoice detail row renders exactly the report's column count in the declared left-to-right order.
2. A cell with nothing to show is rendered blank in its position — never shifted or wrapped; a drifted row is a defect.
3. Both forms of the grand Totals indicator are exempt: the desktop Totals row merges the four leading identifier columns; the mobile bar is not a table row.
